summary: A massive combined strike on Kyiv and Kyiv Oblast is planned within 96 hours, involving up to 700 Shahed drones, 30 Iskander-M ballistic missiles, 18 Iskander-K cruise missiles, 8 S-400 ballistic missiles, 6 Kinzhal hypersonic missiles, and naval aviation assets including 4 missile carriers and strategic bombers. Russian forces launched an overnight attack across northern, southern, and eastern Ukraine with 1 Kh-59/69 missile, 7 ballistic missiles, and 136 drones. A large-scale Russian armored offensive near Shakhovo in Donetsk Oblast involving the 8th and 41st armies and 90th tank division was repelled after four hours of fighting.
key_points: Russia plans a massive combined strike on Kyiv and Kyiv Oblast within 96 hours using 700 Shaheds, 30 Iskander-M, 18 Iskander-K, 8 S-400, 6 Kinzhal, and 4 Black Sea missile carriers with up to 24 Kalibr rockets (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69409).

A Russian armored offensive near Shakhovo, Donetsk Oblast, involving the 8th and 41st armies and 90th tank division was stopped after four hours; 7 tanks, 6 armored vehicles, a Tornado-S launcher, a Grad launcher, and 47 light vehicles were destroyed, with 123 Russian servicemembers killed (Source: @eRadarrua/102728).

Overnight Russian attack on Ukraine included 1 Kh-59/69 missile, 7 Iskander-M/S-400 ballistic missiles, and 136 drones; air defense shot down 1 missile, 5 ballistic missiles, and 104 drones across northern, southern, and eastern sectors (Source: @UkraineNow/82935).

At least 3 unauthorized Russian UAVs, the first confirmed as Shahed type, entered Romanian airspace over the past 3 days; Romania is preparing a diplomatic protest note to Russia (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31930).
A Russian drone struck an ATB supermarket in Chernihiv, killing 2 people including a 10-year-old child and wounding 3 others (Source: @UkraineNow/82942).
Russian forces attacked Zaporizhzhia again, hitting a college, a gas station, and other civilian infrastructure, with fatalities reported (Source: @eRadarrua/102765).
A Russian military train from TOT was struck by a Ukrainian UAV; tanker wagons were engulfed in flames (Source: @eRadarrua/102783).

points: A planned massive combined strike on Kyiv and Kyiv Oblast within 96 hours involves 700 Shahed drones of various types, 30 Iskander-M ballistic missiles, up to 18 Iskander-K cruise missiles, 8 S-400 ballistic missiles, and 6 Kinzhal hypersonic missiles (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69409).

Overnight, Russian forces launched 1 Kh-59/69 missile, 7 Iskander-M/S-400 ballistic missiles, and 136 drones at targets across northern, southern, and eastern Ukraine; air defense destroyed 1 Kh-59/69, 5 ballistic missiles, and 104 Shahed, Gerbera, Italmas, and other drones (Source: @UkraineNow/82935).

In Chernihiv, a Russian drone struck an ATB supermarket, killing 2 people including a 10-year-old child and injuring 3 others, according to the Ministry of Internal Affairs (Source: @UkraineNow/82942).
In Zaporizhzhia, Russian strikes hit a college, a gas station, and other civilian infrastructure, with fatalities confirmed (Source: @eRadarrua/102765).
A terminal in Zaporizhzhie under Ukrainian Armed Forces control burned down after a Russian Armed Forces strike (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31927).
In Kryvyi Rih, Shahed drones struck an Epicentr retail store; no casualties were reported as of the latest update (Source: @UkraineNow/82938).
Romania shot down a third drone in three days; the first was confirmed as a Russian Shahed-type UAV, and Romania is preparing a protest note to Russia (Source: @UkraineNow/82940).

A residential building in Rostov-on-Don was damaged from an air attack; emergency response and temporary relocation for residents are underway, according to the city mayor (Source: @tass_agency/387260).
In Yaroslavl Oblast, a UAV attack disrupted traffic on the exit from Yaroslavl toward Moscow, according to the regional governor (Source: @tass_agency/387265).
In Sevastopol, temporary restrictions on electricity supply were imposed to manage network overload, according to the city governor (Source: @tass_agency/387257).
Yalta in occupied Crimea has had no electricity for the fourth consecutive day, with beaches empty; the blackout was noted by local observers (Source: @eRadarrua/102758).
In occupied Antracit, Luhansk Oblast, Russia celebrated Navy Day with decorations and events (Source: @eRadarrua/102793).
A Russian military train from TOT had tanker wagons engulfed in flames after being struck by a Ukrainian UAV (Source: @eRadarrua/102783).

Near Shakhovo, Donetsk Oblast, a large-scale Russian armored offensive involving the 8th and 41st Russian armies and the 90th Tank Division was repelled after four hours of fighting by Azov, SBU Alpha, and Air Force units (Source: @eRadarrua/102728).

During the Shakhovo battle, Ukrainian forces destroyed 7 tanks, 6 armored vehicles, a Tornado-S launcher, a Grad launcher, 3 engineering vehicles, and 47 light vehicles, killing 123 Russian servicemembers and wounding 29 (Source: @eRadarrua/102728).

The strike plan includes 4 missile carriers in the Black Sea capable of launching up to 24 Kalibr missiles, 2 Tu-95MS bombers capable of launching up to 12 Kh-101 cruise missiles each, 2 Tu-160 bombers with the same capacity, and 1 MiG-31K with 1 Kinzhal aero-ballistic missile (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69409).

key_developments: Russia plans a massive combined strike on Kyiv and Kyiv Oblast within 96 hours using 700 Shahed drones, 30 Iskander-M ballistic missiles, 18 Iskander-K cruise missiles, 8 S-400 ballistic missiles, 6 Kinzhal hypersonic missiles, 4 Black Sea missile carriers with up to 24 Kalibr rockets, 2 Tu-95MS and 2 Tu-160 bombers each carrying up to 12 Kh-101 cruise missiles, and 1 MiG-31K with a Kinzhal missile (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69409).

A large-scale Russian armored offensive near Shakhovo, Donetsk Oblast, involving the 8th and 41st Russian armies and the 90th Tank Division was repelled after four hours of fighting by Ukrainian forces including Azov, SBU Alpha Center for Special Operations, and Air Force units (Source: @eRadarrua/102728).

Overnight Russian attack on Ukraine involved 1 Kh-59/69 missile, 7 Iskander-M/S-400 ballistic missiles, and 136 drones targeting northern, southern, and eastern sectors; Ukrainian air defense intercepted 1 missile, 5 ballistic missiles, and 104 enemy drones including Shahed, Gerbera, Italmas, and other types (Source: @UkraineNow/82935).

At least 3 unauthorized Russian Shahed-type UAVs flew into Romanian airspace over the past 3 days, with Odesa-area attacks regularly spilling into Moldovan and Romanian airspace; Romania is preparing a diplomatic protest note to Russia (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31930, @UkraineNow/82940).

Russian forces struck a college, a gas station, and civilian infrastructure in Zaporizhzhia with fatalities reported; a separate attack hit an ATB supermarket in Chernihiv killing 2 including a 10-year-old child and wounding 3 (Source: @eRadarrua/102765, @UkraineNow/82942).

A Russian military train from TOT had tanker wagons engulfed in flames after Ukrainian UAV strike, and a terminal in Zaporizhzhie under Ukrainian Armed Forces control burned down after a Russian Armed Forces strike (Source: @eRadarrua/102783, @ukr_leaks_eng/31927).
A ballistic threat from the northeast direction was reported, and a threat of ballistic weapons use from the north was flagged by monitoring channels (Source: @eRadarrua/102825, @kpszsu/70288).
sections.threat_assessment: The most significant immediate threat is the planned massive combined strike on Kyiv within 96 hours, involving an unprecedented volume of 700 Shahed drones alongside 30 Iskander-M and 8 S-400 ballistic missiles, 6 Kinzhal hypersonic missiles, and air-launched Kh-101 cruise missiles from Tu-95MS and Tu-160 strategic bombers, supported by Kalibr sea-launched missiles from 4 carriers in the Black Sea. The overnight attack pattern of 136 drones combined with 7 ballistic missiles indicates Russia is maintaining sustained multi-axis pressure across northern, southern, and eastern Ukraine simultaneously. The confirmed incursion of at least 3 Shahed drones into Romanian airspace signals a widening of the conflict's geographic footprint and raises the risk of NATO-member state involvement. The repulsion of the Shakhovo armored offensive demonstrates that large-scale combined-arms Russian assaults remain vulnerable to coordinated Ukrainian defense involving territorial defense, special operations, and air force units.
sections.regional_response: Romania is preparing a formal diplomatic protest note to Russia following three unauthorized Russian UAV incursions over three days, with the first confirmed as a Shahed-type drone, and has shot down a third drone in three days. Ukraine's air defense is actively intercepting threats across multiple axes, having downed 104 drones and 5 ballistic missiles in the overnight engagement alone. The Ukrainian General Staff has publicly denied a report by ukr_leaks_eng about a new C-in-C Drapatiy ordering an army audit, calling the publication fake and stating Drapatiy does not have an X account, suggesting an information operation or impersonation. Panama's MFA has reported the recruitment of Panamanian citizens for combat against Ukraine via Russian embassy channels and is investigating while offering consular assistance.
sections.intelligence_notes: The volume and variety of weapons systems referenced in the Kyiv strike plan — including Kinzhal hypersonic missiles, Iskander-K cruise missiles, and Kalibr sea-launched missiles — indicate a multi-domain combined-arms approach that Russia has not previously attempted at this scale against a single target. The repeated detection of reconnaissance UAVs heading toward Slavutych in Chernihiv Oblast suggests Russian intelligence is tracking the Chernobyl exclusion zone or nearby critical infrastructure. The Russian military train strike from TOT indicates Ukrainian long-range UAV capability reaching into Russian rear areas, while the Yaroslavl UAV attack demonstrates Russian home-front vulnerability extending beyond the front line. The denial by the Ukrainian General Staff regarding C-in-C Drapatiy's audit announcement raises concerns about information integrity and potential impersonation or disinformation campaigns targeting Ukrainian military communications.
